items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Morehouse is an integral member of my organization, the Band of America... Paul Lavalle, Conductor of the City Service Band of America.

ctx.x: Now let's see where are we. Oh as the radio sort of died down in the fifties and television came in, you were of course with the City Service Band and Paul Lavalle. What else were you doing in the sixties? Were you...
